text_simplified: Parents should avoid praying against their children, especially in moments of anger, lest the prayer coincide with an hour of acceptance and they regret it. The Prophet ﷺ forbade praying against oneself, one's children, and one's wealth. Allah has criticized man's haste in praying for evil just as he prays for good. Qatadah said that a person curses his wealth and child, and if Allah responded to him, He would destroy him. Al-Sa'di said this stems from man's ignorance and haste during anger.
